analysis:
This pass covered documentation only. The PR adds a row at docs/architecture/inference.md line 671 (head) and a matching row for the DARKBLOOM_TTFT_FUSED_CAUSAL_PREFILL env var at docs/reference/configuration.md line 313 (head). It also bumps the date at line 3.

The documented behavior: full-attention prompt chunks with fused-eligible head dims take a single .causal SDPA call on either KV backend. Live packed paged KV is excluded. Setting the exact value 0 restores the 128-query blocks, and the variable is read once per process.

This is a performance and numerical path change. It does not touch the crypto, authorization, attestation, cache identity or SSD naming covered by T-041 or SEC-035. The doc text does not alter the cache-salt, TTL or kill-switch semantics.

Potential concerns, which integration should check against the source if it is in another batch:
- A faster prefill could narrow the T-041/SEC-035 TTFT hit/miss oracle margin, but it does not create a new channel.
- Fused causal masking must preserve causal visibility and the vision-span and bidirectional exclusions; otherwise T-007-class output correctness could be affected. That exclusion depends on AttentionV1.swift usesFusedCausalPrefill and PagedLayerCache.swift prefillAttend, which are not supplied here.
- The documented exclusion of live packed paged KV and windowed/softcap attention should be verified in code.

The other displayed sections of inference.md (MTP upgrade, MiMo, Bonsai) are unchanged per the range map. No security regression was identified in the supplied units.
